skill.name: caveman-compress
skill.description: Compresses natural language memory files such as CLAUDE.md, todos, and preferences into shorter markdown. It preserves code blocks, URLs, headings, and paths, then saves the original as FILE.original.md.
skill.summary: Compress markdown memory files to reduce recurring AI context tokens.
skill.author: juliusbrussee

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown backticks, regex patterns, comments, and documented safe credential use. The meaningful residual risks are that selected files are sent to Claude and model output can overwrite future agent memory files.

remediation.issue: Untrusted memory content can influence the replacement file.
remediation.suggestion: Delimit source content clearly, instruct the model to ignore instructions inside source text, and scan output for new agent directives before writing.

remediation.issue: Selected file content is submitted to an external LLM service.
remediation.suggestion: Show a preflight warning before submission and recommend removing secrets from memory files before compression.

remediation.issue: Readable backups may retain sensitive content beside the compressed file.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that FILE.original.md may be committed and recommend adding backup patterns to project ignore rules.

semantic_findings.title: External LLM Submission of Local File Content
semantic_findings.description: The selected file content is embedded in a Claude prompt and sent through the Anthropic SDK or Claude CLI. Users can disclose sensitive memory notes if they compress confidential files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow is direct: original file text is inserted into the prompt and submitted to Claude. The risk depends on user-selected file sensitivity, but the external submission is clear.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Prompt Injection Through Compressed Memory
semantic_findings.description: The model output is written back to the original memory file after compressing untrusted file text. A hostile source file could influence the model to add future agent instructions to CLAUDE.md.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt includes the original content and the resulting text overwrites the memory file. Exploitation requires malicious content in the selected file, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.value_statement: Large project memory files consume tokens every time an AI coding session starts. This skill compresses prose memory files while preserving technical details and saving a readable backup.
actual_capabilities: Detects natural language files and skips common code or configuration extensions.
Compresses markdown, text, and extensionless prose through Claude.
Preserves headings, code blocks, URLs, paths, commands, and inline code during validation.
Creates a FILE.original.md backup before replacing the selected file.
Retries targeted fixes up to two times when validation errors occur.
Rejects files larger than 500 KB before any Claude call.
limitations: Requires an Anthropic API key or an authenticated Claude CLI session.
Sends the selected file content to Claude for compression.
Designed for prose memory files, not source code or configuration files.
Validation cannot prove that every natural language nuance is preserved.

use_cases.title: Reduce Recurring Project Context
use_cases.description: Compress CLAUDE.md so each Claude Code or Codex session loads fewer repeated tokens.

use_cases.title: Maintain Compact Team Notes
use_cases.description: Shorten project preferences, todo files, and onboarding notes while keeping links and commands intact.

use_cases.title: Prepare Memory Files for Long Projects
use_cases.description: Trim large prose memory files before starting long-running tasks that need stable context.

prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner use on a known memory file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use caveman-compress on CLAUDE.md and tell me where the backup was saved.

prompt_templates.title: Compress Project Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Compress a markdown note file with validation feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compress docs/project-notes.md, preserve headings and links, and report any validation warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Check Before Compression
prompt_templates.scenario: Verify that a target file is suitable before changing it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether todos.md is a safe natural language target, then compress it only if it passes detection.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Memory Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup across several project memory files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find project memory files that are safe compression candidates, explain the order, and compress selected files one at a time with validation.

output_examples.output: Compression completed. CLAUDE.md now contains compressed instructions, and CLAUDE.original.md contains the readable backup.
Compressed file saved after validation. Headings, links, code blocks, and paths were preserved.

output_examples.input: Try to compress a configuration file.
output_examples.output: The file was skipped because it was classified as code or configuration, not natural language prose.

best_practices: Review the readable backup before committing compressed memory changes.
Remove secrets and private notes before sending a file for compression.
Use the skill on focused memory files instead of broad mixed-content documents.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to compress source code, environment files, or configuration files.
Do not ignore validation warnings when paths, links, or bullets changed unexpectedly.
Do not run it on untrusted memory files without reviewing the output first.

faq.question: What files should I use with this skill?
faq.answer: Use it with markdown, text, or extensionless prose files that store project memory, preferences, or todo notes.

faq.question: Does it preserve code blocks?
faq.answer: Yes. The validation checks compare fenced code blocks and report errors if they changed.

faq.question: Where is the original file saved?
faq.answer: The original content is saved beside the target file as FILE.original.md before replacement.

faq.question: Can it run without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set, it uses the authenticated Claude CLI fallback.

faq.question: Will it compress code or configuration?
faq.answer: No. It skips common code and configuration extensions, including environment files and lock files.

faq.question: Is the file content sent outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected file content is sent to Claude through the Anthropic SDK or Claude CLI.
